lines: “Bahūnaṃ vata atthāyā”ti osānagāthāyapi satthu lokassa bahūpakārataṃyeva vibhāveti.
Yaṃ panettha atthato na vibhattaṃ, taṃ suviññeyyameva.

after.title: Mahāpajāpatigotamītherīgāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Athekadā mahāpajāpatigotamī satthari vesāliyaṃ viharante mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ sayaṃ vesāliyaṃ bhikkhunupassaye viharantī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā attano divāṭṭhāne yathāparicchinnakālaṃ phalasamāpattisukhena vītināmetvā phalasamāpattito vuṭṭhāya attano paṭipattiṃ paccavekkhitvā somanassajātā attano āyusaṅkhāre āvajjentī tesaṃ khīṇabhāvaṃ ñatvā evaṃ cintesi –
“yaṃnūnāhaṃ vihāraṃ gantvā bhagavantaṃ anujānāpetvā manobhāvanīye ca there sabbeva sabrahmacariye āpucchitvā idheva āgantvā parinibbāyeyya”nti.
Yathā ca theriyā, evaṃ tassā parivārabhūtānaṃ pañcannaṃ bhikkhunisatānaṃ parivitakko ahosi.

after.title: Mahāpajāpatigotamītherīgāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tahiṃ kate pure ramme, vasī bhikkhunupassaye.
